svg.title: SkyQ RANGE fixed-size equity curves for SPY and QQQ
svg.desc: Closed-trade equity from a $1,000,000 starting account with a fixed 1,000 shares and no compounding, after modeled commissions and slippage. SPY ends at 2,658,828; QQQ ends at 1,484,445.

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
